name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad’s journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, spending countless hours at local tracks absorbing every detail. He transitioned from a keen observer to a hands-on mechanic, honing his skills in vehicle dynamics and engine tuning. Recognizing his aptitude for leadership, Ahmad pursued a degree in Motorsports Engineering, combining his practical knowledge with theoretical expertise. His career took off after joining a local racing team, where he quickly rose through the ranks, showcasing his ability to orchestrate successful race strategies and foster a collaborative team environment.

As Sporting Director for Birel ART Factory, Ahmad brings a unique blend of technical acumen and strategic foresight. He's known for his meticulous preparation, data-driven decision-making, and unwavering commitment to nurturing talent within the team. Ahmad's approach is characterized by a relentless pursuit of innovation, constantly seeking marginal gains through advanced technologies and unconventional strategies. His distinctive quality lies in his ability to inspire and motivate the team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and shared success.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing his team jacket.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with racing diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the karts before every race, regardless of the hour.
